first_impression: Discord shows an invitation to join the Devpost server, with member counts and an account creation form.
action_attempted: Entered a non-personal display name in the invite form.
after_state: The display name was accepted, but account creation remained unavailable until required birth-date and terms fields were completed.
notes: The URL leads to a Discord community invite rather than a directly demonstrated Actionflow interface.

first_impression: A private workspace opens with three existing boards, search, import/export, and a prominent New board control.
action_attempted: Opened the starred board titled My first YouTube video.
after_state: The board opened successfully as the next workspace view.
notes: No credentials were required; the workspace was populated on arrival.

first_impression: A landing page introduces AdapTab as WebMCP for every tab and lists adapter examples for several services.
after_state: The build-adapter destination was reached, demonstrating a path toward creating an adapter.
notes: The page also exposes a private workspace and adapter catalog entry points.

first_impression: Aegis Command presents a sparse dispatch map with three active deployed units and a unit search field.
after_state: The search completed without an error and the dispatch view remained available for the selected unit.
notes: The visible workflow is map/unit lookup; radio-call transformation was not exposed in the initial view.

first_impression: AEON presents an agent-economy landing page centered on giving an agent a goal and boundaries, with mission and marketplace actions.
notes: The page explicitly frames intent, constitution, and agency as the control model.

first_impression: A live geometry workspace opens with a preloaded nonagon mission, creation tools, algebra input, and a command line.
action_attempted: Changed the project title to Observer geometry test and clicked Save.
after_state: The save action completed while the geometry workspace and existing grouped objects remained visible.
notes: The shared editable geometry and exact object list were directly visible without login.
